business_summary: Xizi Clean Energy Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides energy utilization and engineering solutions in China and internationally. It offers gas turbine waste heat boiler; dry coke quenching waste heat boiler; sintering machine waste heat boilers; cement kiln waste heat boilers; hot water boilers; and power station boilers, such as circulating fluidized bed boilers, pulverized coal furnaces, and blast furnace gas. The company also provides power station auxiliary equipment, including high- and low-pressure heaters, deaerators, and condensers; waste incineration, biomass, natural gas, wastewater, and gas boilers; sludge boilers, molten salt heat absorbers, exchangers, and storage tanks; low temperature nitrogen combustion; SCR/SNCR equipment; and nuclear power equipment comprising nuclear power conventional island auxiliaries, and civil nuclear secondary and third level equipment. In addition, it offers thermal oil heat, petrochemical, and chemical heat exchangers, as well as other heat exchangers; seawater desalination equipment devices; gasifiers; EP/EPC/PC projects; pressure vessels; spare parts, such as super heaters, economizers, and other components; and technical services, project modifications, engineering, repair, maintenance, and other services. The company was formerly known as Hangzhou Boiler Group Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Xizi Clean Energy Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd. in January 2022. Xizi Clean Energy Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Xizi Clean Energy Equipment Manufacturing Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 에너지 활용 및 엔지니어링 솔루션을 제공합니다. 가스 터빈 폐열 보일러를 제공합니다. 건식 코크스 담금질 폐열 보일러; 소결 기계 폐열 보일러; 시멘트 가마 폐열 보일러; 온수 보일러; 순환유동층 보일러, 미분탄로, 고로가스 등의 발전소 보일러 등을 들 수 있다. 이 회사는 또한 고압 및 저압 히터, 탈기기 및 응축기를 포함한 발전소 보조 장비를 제공합니다. 폐기물 소각, 바이오매스, 천연가스, 폐수 및 가스 보일러; 슬러지 보일러, 용융염 열 흡수기, 교환기 및 저장 탱크; 저온 질소 연소; SCR/SNCR 장비; 원자력 재래식 섬 보조 시설, 민간 원자력 2차 및 3급 장비로 구성된 원자력 장비. 또한 열매체열, 석유화학, 화학 열교환기와 기타 열교환기를 제공합니다. 해수 담수화 장비 장치; 가스화기; EP/EPC/PC 프로젝트; 압력 용기; 슈퍼히터, 이코노마이저 등의 예비 부품
